t: The warning about how a life ends
a: إِنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ لَيَعْمَلُ بِعَمَلِ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ حَتَّى مَا يَكُونَ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَهَا إِلاَّ ذِرَاعٌ فَيَسْبِقُ عَلَيْهِ الْكِتَابُ
p: Inna aḥadakum la-yaʿmalu bi-ʿamali ahli-l-jannati ḥattā mā yakūnu baynahu wa baynahā illā dhirāʿun fa-yasbiqu ʿalayhi-l-kitāb
m: One of you does the work of the people of the Garden until there is only a forearm's length between him and it, and then what was written overtakes him.
